SUMMARY
Exceptional south-facing waterfront apartment with panoramic views of Plymouth Sound and Drake's Island, private balcony, secure parking, lift access and stylish open-plan living.

DESCRIPTION
Commanding an enviable waterfront position, this superb one-bedroom apartment enjoys breathtaking south-facing views across Plymouth Sound, Drake's Island and the open sea beyond. Beautifully presented throughout, the property offers a rare opportunity to experience luxury coastal living in one of Plymouth's most sought-after marina locations.

The beautifully proportioned open-plan living space is flooded with natural light through floor-to-ceiling glazing, perfectly framing the ever-changing seascape. A contemporary kitchen integrates seamlessly with the living and dining area, creating an elegant space for entertaining or simply relaxing while enjoying the spectacular outlook.

A private balcony extends the living accommodation outdoors and can be accessed directly from the lounge. Whether enjoying a morning coffee watching the boats glide across the Sound or unwinding as the sun sets over the water, this exceptional vantage point provides a truly captivating backdrop.

The generous double bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, complete with stunning views, while excellent storage solutions and a stylish bathroom enhance both comfort and practicality.

Further benefits include secure underground gated parking, lift access to all floors and full compliance with current building safety regulations, ensuring complete peace of mind.

Combining contemporary design, unrivalled views and an exceptional waterfront setting,

Kitchen/Diner/Living Room 23' 1" x 10' 11" ( 7.04m x 3.33m )

Bedroom 12' 1" x 7' 10" ( 3.68m x 2.39m )

Balcony 10' 11" x 5' 3" ( 3.33m x 1.60m )
